recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, stylized portrait of a central figure set against a background of alternating vertical stripes. The image uses a limited, vibrant palette with flat color fills and heavy black shadows to create a screen-printed effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject overlaps the background stripes and the header typography
High-contrast black shadows define the subject's features against flat color fills
Typography spans the full width of the top edge, acting as a frame
Color blocking in the clothing mirrors the saturation of the background
coreInvariants: Evenly spaced vertical stripes in two alternating colors
High-contrast black ink threshold for facial features and hair
Flat, unshaded color fills for skin and clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, medium shot from waist up, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, rendered in high-contrast black and white/flesh tone.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large header text, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the vertical stripes to the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The striped background provides rhythmic negative space around the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues with extreme value contrast between black shadows and bright fills.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold sans-serif with a slight italic slant
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are filled with alternating colors from the palette
White drop shadow or offset outline to separate text from background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large italicized display face paired with a smaller, widely-spaced geometric sans for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and clean sans-serif structure of the header.
Appropriate for the geometric, wide-tracked subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a background of alternating vertical cyan and yellow stripes. Place a high-contrast, screen-print style portrait of a person in the center. The person should have flat color fills for skin (peach) and clothes (light blue shirt, pink pants) with heavy black shadows defining the hair and facial features.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, italicized sans-serif text across the top. Fill letters with alternating purple, red, and white colors, and add a thin white offset outline. Add a small, right-aligned subtitle in black geometric sans-serif with wide tracking below the main header.

verificationChecks: Are the stripes perfectly vertical and alternating?
Is the portrait rendered with high-contrast black shadows and flat color fills?
Does the header text span the width of the image?
Is the color palette limited to vibrant, flat hues?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all graphic elements
High-contrast threshold effect on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no photographic gradients remain in the subject.
Check that the text outline is a crisp offset, not a glow.
Verify the stripes are consistent in width.
Confirm the black shadows are deep and solid.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast threshold portrait + flat color fills + alternating vertical stripe background + bold italicized header with offset outline.
